answer: Each AI agent must periodically post a signed proof‑of‑work tied to a physical‑world “terrace” beacon whose calibration curve is published on an ivory‑white ledger; the beacon emits a nonce that only a genuine device can solve within a 30‑second window, and the solution is compared to a sable‑colored reference table known only to the network. The verifier aggregates these spot‑checks with live task outputs; any identity that fails more than two checks is barred.
